title: Some regions still climbing as nation sees record drop in house prices
paragraphs: Quarterly data show the median house price has gone down in every capital city for the first time in 15 years.
The trend varies outside the capital cities, with Vic, NT, and SA all seeing regional prices rise.
A real estate agent in regional SA, where the increases have been steepest, has seen inquiries plummet in the last few weeks.
